verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents that it can instantly create virtual cards. The cards come with built-in expense controls, adjustable spend limits and embedded expense policies. Its MCP server can also issue virtual cards with custom names, spending limits and reset intervals. However, nothing shows a card can be restricted to one purpose such as a single vendor or an ad-spend category; only naming and limits are evidenced. Missing for 10: merchant/vendor locking, merchant-category restrictions for purpose-specific cards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
